fix: Portrait: stack lap tile, gauge and checklist in one column with 8 CSS px gaps (gauge below the lap tile, not under it) and move the item orb and coin chip to a row below the place tile. Landscape: dock the map at least 8 CSS px below the place tile. Test: no two HUD bounding boxes intersect in high/mobile/R04, R07, R08, R17 or high/landscape/R04, R07, R08, R17.

Fade or offset tree canopies (not just trunks) inside the chase camera's near volume, and fade a tub's ring and particles together with its body. Test: no single canopy covers more than 8% of high/desktop/R08, R11 or R19 (now ~12%, ~24%, ~15%), and no ring arc without its tub in high/desktop/R19 or low/desktop/R19.

Apply per-ring distance fog so each horizon ring sits between the ground in front and the sky, and clamp the farthest ring below sky luma. Test: in R05 and R06 nearest-ridge luma is at least 1.25x the mid-distance tree luma (now 78.5 vs 74) and at most 0.85x the sky; each further ring is lighter than the one in front and darker than the sky (now 207 vs 201 in R05, 215 vs 207 in R17).

At the sunset preset raise the hemisphere sky term and add a warm low rim or fill on figures and canopies (about +0.5 EV in shadow), leaving dusk unchanged. Test: in high/desktop/R11 at most 15% of the central frame (15-85% width, 15-95% height) below luma 40 (now 43%), near-right canopy at 900-1000, 200-280 at least luma 45 (now 28), clean sunlit road at least luma 95 (now ~84); high/desktop/R07 keeps at least 10% below luma 40 (now 17%).

Give spectators and the judge the crew's glossy plastic material and printed-face style, add three or more hair and hat variants from crew parts, and ban the cyan tee + flat brown hair cap + dark trousers combination (reads as Minecraft's default character). Test: crowd heads in high/desktop/R13 and R15 show a specular highlight, and no crowd figure in any capture uses that combination.

Emit slide puffs from the rear wheel contacts, growing in size and opacity with charge: blue-white at charge start (already present), white at warm, orange at hot. Fire the WARM/HOT callouts only together with that visual, plus a release burst. Test: strips/high/R14 frames 5-8 have no spray clump more than 10 px from a wheel; high/desktop/R17 has at least 1,500 orange px (hue 15-45 deg, s>0.55, v>0.7) within 150 px of the rear wheels (now 32, none from spray); high/desktop/R19 has at least 800 soft-white px within 120 px of the wheels.

BIG LEVER. Replace the flat stepped column walls with three depth bands of brick-built Ouachita ridges: overlapping rounded ridgelines of stepped plates with instanced low-LOD tree crowns and a darker tree-line band. Cap the near band's height so it never forms a sheer cliff (R06 left third), and reshape Hot Springs Mountain's face. Test (geometry only; haze is G-backdrop-haze-ramp): in R05, R06, R09, R12 and R17 no uniform ridge run longer than 60 px horizontally, at least 3 tree crowns per 100 px of ridge, and no vertical ridge face taller than 15% of the frame height.

At 844x390 narrow the team panel to at most 60% of the width or shift the turntable camera so the crew and tub sit in the free area. Test: in high/landscape/R02 the full tub and every crew figure are visible outside the panel (now an ~80 px sliver at x 1280-1360).

Canopy studs already exist (R05, R09). Add an edge-highlight term or a one-plate chamfer to canopy plate edges, facade corners, storey ledges and roof edges, plus a light brick bevel normal map on facades. Test: near canopy sides in high/desktop/R10 vary by at least 15 luma along a lit edge (now flat 78-79 at 1140-1260, 290-320); facade corners in R05 and R13 show a lit bevel line.

Float a small, unoutlined team-colour pip above each rival captain within 60 m (smaller than the player's marker), so tubs in a single-file pack keep separate cues. Test: in high/desktop/R04 and R07 at least 5 rival tubs are individually marked.

Use one key colour per team across the team-select swatch, ring, flag and tub stripe (Trail Shredders: swatch (240,127,34), ring and stripe (114,170,56)). Test: every team's ring hue is within 20 deg of its swatch hue.

Give the gauge tile the slate fill, dark outline and bevel of the lap and place tiles; put the desktop minimap on a matching tile; restyle the teal WARM/HOT callouts as studded slate plates like the R16 banner; move the item count to its own badge outside the orb. Test: one tile style across R04, R16, R17 and R19; the item count is at least 12 CSS px and does not overlap the orb outline at 1280, 390 and 844 px.
